About this edition

This collection is based on the 1930 Cook Book compiled by the Mayflower Guild of First Congregational Church in Kalamazoo, Michigan. Its 708 recipes have been edited from the historical source for clear, practical use.

The original book remains the historical record. This searchable edition preserves source identifiers, contributors, and page references wherever available.
